summary: The agent implements a basic LightGBM solution with 5-fold cross-validation but completely neglects data cleaning and feature engineering. Furthermore, the agent introduces critical bugs by independently casting train and test object columns to categorical types (which can lead to mismatched internal mappings) and arbitrarily reusing the early stopping iteration from only the final CV fold for the full-dataset retraining.
